description: minimax-h3/generate's refusals: h3_generate_error(node, refs, first, last, width, height, frames = 124, videos = [], audios = []) → the run's error text, or null (contracts/README.md, the minimax-h3 family). refs = the number of image reference rows, first / last = whether those inputs are wired, frames = the clip's frames, videos = [seconds read, sound] per video row (sound: kept and the take has sound), audios = seconds read per audio row (API 1.22). The runner fails the run with the text before the h3 child starts. From API 1.37: a video row may be [seconds, sound, soundtrack seconds or null] with sound "replace"; a tenth arg speed = [layers, reuse, token reduction, render] (Base; null on Base fp8). `render`: h3_render_size(width, height, render) → [w, h] or null
